title: OYSTER AND PEANUT SOUP
instructions: Take half a pound of shelled and roasted peanuts, well pounded. Add two spoonfuls of flour, mix well, boil a pint of oyster water and mix with the peanuts and flour, let it thicken slowly for fifteen minutes, stirring all the time. Add a pint of oysters and let them cook five minutes. Flavor with salt,  red and black pepper. --JOSEPHINE NICAUD.
